summary: Expand Motonomaad scope to include a polished marketing/landing website (in addition to the app) with standard company pages/content such as About Us.
architectural_notes: Brand rename: update all user-facing strings/assets from "Motonomad" to "Motonomaad" consistently across the site/app.
Typography decision: use “Black Ops One” for headings (display/heading font).
Color direction: use orange prominently with dark/black alternative backgrounds to enhance contrast; allow red accents where appropriate.
Visual theme refinement: adjust the balance between stronger primary orange accents, selective red highlight accents, and a deeper near-black background tone to improve contrast and premium feel.
Add subtle, consistent UI motion/animation guidelines (hover/focus/enter transitions) to improve overall polish without hurting performance or accessibility (prefers-reduced-motion).
Hero tagline styling: “RIDE FREE. RIDE FAR.” should use Black Ops One, with the word “FREE” colored in orange.

existing_features.title: Create the Motonomad MVP information architecture and navigation with these top-level areas: Trip Planner, Mechanics, Social Feed, Groups, Events, and Profile.
Implement Internet Identity sign-in and a basic authenticated user experience (signed-in vs signed-out) across the app.
Trip Planner: provide a form where a rider enters source, destination, number of days, and type of ride, and display a curated list of itinerary suggestions returned from the backend.
Mechanics: implement a directory of certified mechanics and a contact/request flow where a user can submit a troubleshooting request to a selected mechanic.
Social Feed: allow signed-in users to create posts to showcase rides/gear and allow all users to browse the feed.
Groups: implement creating groups, browsing groups, joining/leaving groups, and viewing a group details page with membership list/count.
Events: implement creating events, browsing upcoming events, joining/leaving events, and viewing event details (date/time, location text, description).

Profile: implement a profile page that shows the signed-in user’s basic info and their content/participation (their posts, groups they joined, events they joined, and mechanic contact requests they created).
Apply a coherent visual theme for Motonomad (distinct style, colors, typography, spacing, and components) suitable for motorcycle travel/community, and enforce it consistently across all pages.
Add generated static brand assets (logo + hero/illustrations) to the frontend as static files and use them in the UI (e.g., header/logo area and landing/empty states).

Create a new public landing home page at route "/" that functions as a full marketing website entry point for Motonomad (not the Trip Planner), with high-quality sections such as: hero, product overview, key features, how it works, and clear calls-to-action to explore the app features.
Add standard marketing/company pages and routes, including an "About Us" page, and ensure they are accessible from the site navigation and footer.

Update routing and navigation so the marketing website and the existing app sections coexist cleanly: keep the current app feature routes (Trip Planner, Mechanics, Social, Groups, Events, Profile) and add marketing links without breaking existing navigation behavior.

Add a new "Timeline" section to the marketing landing page at route "/" (frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx) that visually presents a short product/company roadmap/history as a sequence of milestones with a consistent layout and responsive styling.

Add a new "FAQ" section to the marketing landing page at route "/" (frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx) that presents common questions and answers in an accessible expand/collapse format using native HTML (<details>/<summary>) or existing UI components without modifying any files under frontend/src/components/ui.
Rename all user-facing branding text from “Motonomad” to “Motonomaad” across the marketing website and app UI, including the logo text, footer copyright line, and landing page copy.

Update the BrandLogo component styling so the logo/wordmark feels more intuitive and premium by using a more distinctive font treatment and a cohesive color treatment that fits the existing site theme (without changing any files under frontend/src/components/ui).

Update the rendered logo image asset usage to match the corrected brand spelling by adding a new generated logo image file and updating the BrandLogo component to reference it (keeping assets served statically from frontend/public/assets/generated).
Update the HTML document title to use the corrected brand spelling “Motonomaad”.

Update the marketing landing page hero copy to include a punchy tagline styled similarly to the uploaded reference image (short uppercase kicker line + bold, high-impact headline), while keeping the brand name as “Motonomaad”.

Refresh the site-wide typography by replacing the current Google Fonts and updating Tailwind font families so the app/marketing pages feel less “boring” and more premium, including clear separation between body font and display/heading font.

Align brand wordmark styling with the new typography by updating the BrandLogo wordmark styling rules so the header/footer wordmark matches the updated font direction (without changing any files under frontend/src/components/ui).
Load the Google Font “Black Ops One” in the app and apply it as the site-wide heading typeface (h1–h6) by updating the Tailwind heading font family used by the existing global heading styles.
Update the global Tailwind theme tokens to use an orange-forward palette and a near-black (black alternative) background so orange elements have strong contrast, in both light and dark modes.

Replace the current green/forest accent color token with a red accent token and ensure it is used only as an accent (not replacing primary orange), including gradients and decorative elements that reference the accent token.

Audit top-level page sections (marketing and app) to ensure backgrounds and overlays complement the orange primary on dark/near-black backgrounds, adjusting any page-level utility classes that cause low contrast or clashing hues.

Adjust the global theme color tokens to create (1) a deeper near-black background in dark mode, (2) stronger/more vibrant orange primary accents, and (3) more noticeable red accent highlights, by updating the CSS custom properties in frontend/src/index.css for both :root and .dark.

Update brand wordmark and glow styling in frontend/src/index.css so the orange-to-red gradient and glow intensity match the updated stronger orange primary and stronger red accent (including the .dark variant), while keeping the wordmark legible on the deeper near-black background.

Strengthen the visible orange/red accents on the marketing landing page by adjusting section-level utility classes that currently use very subtle `from-primary/5` / `to-accent/5` gradients (e.g., the hero section and CTA card in frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx) so the accent presence is more pronounced and complements the deeper near-black background in dark mode.

Generate and add a new, higher-quality Motonomaad logo image asset (same brand spelling: “Motonomaad”) and update the existing logo usage so the site uses the new logo consistently anywhere the BrandLogo image is rendered.

Add tasteful, performant transitions/animations across the site (marketing pages and app sections) using Tailwind utilities and existing animation tooling, focusing on subtle page/section entrance transitions and interactive hover/focus micro-interactions without harming readability or performance.

Refine the BrandLogo presentation to feel more premium by tuning sizing, spacing, and hover behavior for both the logo mark image and the “Motonomaad” wordmark, while keeping the current spelling and existing logo image asset path unchanged.

Update the global brand CSS rules for `.brand-wordmark` and `.brand-logo-glow` in `frontend/src/index.css` to fine-tune gradient, contrast, and glow intensity for both light and dark modes, ensuring legibility on near-black backgrounds.

Fix the header logo link structure to avoid nested navigation links by ensuring only a single interactive link wraps the BrandLogo in the header (either BrandLogo owns the link, or AppShell does), while keeping the same click target behavior (navigates to “/”).

Update the marketing landing page hero headline “RIDE FREE. RIDE FAR.” (frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx) so the headline uses the “Black Ops One” typeface, and ensure the word “FREE” renders in orange (the primary theme color) as a filled text color (not transparent/outline-only).

new_feature_requests.summary: Trip planner: user enters source, destination, number of days, and ride type to receive curated itinerary suggestions
Mechanic contact feature to reach certified mechanics for troubleshooting/help
Social feed/profile to showcase rides, gear, and related content
Groups feature for riders to join communities within the platform
Events feature for hosting and joining motorcycle ride events

Implement backend data models and persistence for: user profile, trip itinerary suggestions, mechanic directory entries, mechanic contact requests, social posts, groups, group membership, events, and event attendance.
Create a polished, full-fledged marketing landing website for Motonomad including sections/pages like About Us (and other standard company/marketing content)
Add an FAQ section to the Motonomad marketing/landing website
Add a timeline section (e.g., product/company roadmap/history) to the Motonomad marketing/landing website
Update the brand/logo design to feel more intuitive by using improved fonts and color schemes
Rename branding/site text from "Motonomad" to "Motonomaad" across the product/marketing website
Add a brand tagline (e.g., on the landing page hero/header) to strengthen Motonomaad messaging
Refresh site typography by updating fonts to feel less boring/more premium across the marketing site/app UI
Use the Google Font “Black Ops One” for headings across the site/app typography
Update site/app visual theme to use an orange-forward palette with dark/black alternative backgrounds for contrast, with optional red accents
Add tasteful site-wide transitions/animations (e.g., page/section/component transitions) to improve polish and perceived quality
Update hero tagline “RIDE FREE. RIDE FAR.” styling: set font to Black Ops One and color the word “FREE” in orange
